title: AITI Talk
text:
Goal is to give an introductory talk about R software and ecosystem, and how it can be useful to produce data products such as reports with tables and visualisations. In particular, I will show how to use R to “reproduce” some elements of the the AITI ICT Survey Report 2022.
The format will be lecture style with hands-on “follow along” (code will be provided). There will be two teaching assistants on hand to help out with any questions. Everyone should bring their own laptop with R and RStudio installed.
No prior knowledge of R is required.
